# OSM Ambalaj

> Since 2002, OSM Ambalaj has been manufacturing A-Box, crash-lock bottom, die-cut, tray and partitioned corrugated boxes in Sarayönü, Konya, Türkiye.

- Founded: 2002
- Address: Kurşunlu Mah. Yeni İstanbul Cad. No:626 Sarayönü / Konya, Türkiye
- Phone: 0332 239 19 71
- GSM: 0533 680 91 29
- E-mail: selim@osmambalaj.com.tr

## Products

### Standard Boxes
- [A-Box Boxes](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/a-box-boxes/): The world's most preferred box style for shipping and storage.
- [Crash-Lock Bottom Boxes](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/crash-lock-bottom-boxes/): Boxes with an interlocking bottom that set up in seconds without tape.
- [Export Boxes](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/export-boxes/): Durable boxes for long-haul and container transport that meet export requirements.

### Custom Design Boxes
- [Die-Cut Boxes](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/die-cut-boxes/): Precision die-cut templates for special products; tape-free assembly designs.
- [Tray Boxes](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/tray-boxes/): Open-top tray boxes for fruit and vegetables, food and display use.
- [Partitioned Boxes](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/partitioned-boxes/): Boxes with internal dividers that protect delicate products one by one.

### Corrugated Flute Types
- [E Flute](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/e-flute/): With many flutes per metre it offers excellent flat crush resistance; a lightweight flute type that gives the best printing results.
- [B Flute](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/b-flute/): A flute type with low flute height and pitch, resistant to flat crushing and suitable for printing.
- [C Flute](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/c-flute/): Developed after B flute; a flute type with good load-bearing properties and good printing results.
- [E+B Flute](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/eb-flute/): A high-strength double wall combining a micro (E) and a fine (B) flute.
- [B+C Flute](https://r-fatih.github.io/osmambalaj-demo/en/products/bc-flute/): A double wall for heavy loads, combining a fine (B) and a coarse (C) flute.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What products does OSM Ambalaj manufacture?**
We manufacture A-Box (regular slotted), crash-lock bottom, die-cut, tray, partitioned and export boxes, made from E, B, C and double-wall (E+B, B+C) corrugated board in the flute type that suits your product.

**Do you make custom-size and printed boxes?**
Yes. We produce our boxes to order in custom sizes with a design suited to your product and needs, and printing is available.

**Which flute type should I choose?**
E flute suits consumer and gift packaging that needs print quality, B flute suits die-cut boxes and C flute suits shipping boxes. For heavy loads and export packaging, E+B or B+C double wall is preferred. Our team will recommend the right flute type for your product.

**Are your products recyclable?**
Yes, our corrugated board products are 100% recyclable. We source raw materials locally and carry out all production in our own facility.

**Where is your factory?**
Our factory is located at Kurşunlu Mah. Yeni İstanbul Cad. No:626, Sarayönü / Konya, Türkiye, with a 5,500 m² covered production area. We have been manufacturing since 2002.

**How can I get a quote?**
Simply fill in the quote form on our website with the product type, approximate dimensions and quantity. You can also call us by phone.
